docs.title: Cloud-Native Perceptual Image Deduplication
docs.text:
Welcome to the technical documentation for the dissertation project.

This documentation tracks the project evolution from a local three-stage image deduplication pipeline to planned cloud-native deployment and operations.

docs.title: Documentation Scope
docs.text:
• Core deduplication pipeline (SHA-256, pHash, SSIM)
  • Benchmarking and correctness evaluation
  • Threshold tuning and baseline selection
  • Reproducibility assets and submission evidence
  • Cloud-native integration roadmap and implementation phases

docs.title: Current Status
docs.text:
• ✅ Local pipeline implemented
  • ✅ Benchmarking and evaluation tooling implemented
  • ✅ Threshold tuning completed
  • ✅ Final reproducible baseline established
  • ⏳ Cloud-native integration phases in progress

docs.title: Phase Notes
docs.text:
• Phase 01: Local Pipeline Foundation

  • Phase 04: Containerisation and Runtime Configuration
  • Phase 05: Async Job Orchestration and Worker Model
  • Phase 06: Observability and Resilience Hardening
  • Phase 07: Cloud Deployment and Scale Validation
